readme: 0. Install uv https://github.com/astral-sh/uv?tab=readme-ov-file#installation 1. clone the repo git clone https://github.com/freemocap/freemocap 2. Change directory to the repo: cd freemocap 3. Change to the development branch: git switch development 4. Create virtual environment: uv venv 5. Activate virtual environment Windows: .venv/bin/activate Mac/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate 6. Install dependencies uv sync — installs skellytracker with NVIDIA GPU acceleration on Windows/Linux, or CPU-only on macOS, automatically No supported GPU on Windows/Linux?
